channel.title: Ajaz Ahmed Siddiqui
channel.description: Practical notes on Entra ID, identity governance, cloud security, and automation.

item.title: Modernizing IAM with Entra ID
item.description: Learn how I used Entra ID to automate IAM workflows, including Access Packages, JIT access, and recurring reviews—reducing manual overhead by 80% and improving audit readiness.

item.title: Zero Trust & PAM for 250K Devices
item.description: Discover how I deployed Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM) and Administrator Protection at scale—enabling JIT elevation, reducing admin rights by 95%, and enhancing visibility through dashboards and automation.

item.title: Seamless Entra ID & Azure Migrations
item.description: Led global Microsoft Entra ID tenant and Azure subscription migrations with zero downtime and 99.9% uptime. Delivered secure identity isolation and automated transitions across hybrid environments.

item.title: Securing Email Communication with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC
item.description: Explore how Microsoft 365, combined with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC, strengthens email trust and defends against phishing and spoofing through DNS authentication, cryptographic signing, and enforced domain policies.

item.title: Why Identity Security Is Critical for AI Safety
item.description: Exploring how AI agents become identities with permissions, tokens, and API keys—and why applying RBAC, Zero Trust, and secrets management is essential to prevent over-permissioned agents and data leaks.

item.title: Human-in-the-Loop Power App for SAM
item.description: Learn how a human-in-the-loop Power App integrates PowerApps, Copilot Studio, and Generative AI workflows to help SAM teams manage applications, suppliers, and contracts efficiently while maintaining oversight and enabling data-driven decisions.

item.title: Zero Trust Strategy for Identity Security
item.description: Explore how implementing a Zero Trust framework strengthens identity security by enforcing least privilege, adaptive access, and continuous verification across users, devices, and workloads.

item.title: Native Deployment with Power Platform Pipelines
item.description: Discover how native Power Platform pipelines streamline solution deployments across environments—and the gotchas I hit along the way: connection reference identities, late-failing environment variables, and the tricks that make releases repeatable.

item.title: What's New in Entra ID Governance
item.description: A practitioner's rundown of the Entra ID governance changes that shipped between June and October 2026 — user-centric access reviews, tenant governance, lifecycle workflow upgrades, hard-match hardening, guest billing enforcement, and what's coming for AI agent identities — plus what to do about each one.
